top_signals.title: Bond sell-off rocks Europe after France imposes curfew to contain riots
top_signals.summary: European bond and equity markets were hit by a fresh sell-off on Monday as the French government rolled out curfews to contain explosive riots that have spread across the country. The 10-year yield on French bonds – a direct reflection of the government’s cost to borrow – spiked around 13 basis points to 4.9 per [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: SkyAI sells off entire Solana treasury as it launches $201 million buyback
top_signals.summary: SkyAI holds $223.8 million in cash after selling all its SOL, with its $3 buyback running through Oct. 29.
